name: Soren
title: Lampwright of the Flamehouse
examine: Carried the daughter-flame south in a pilgrim lamp, on foot, down the whole unlit road. Trims every wick he passes. He is building lamps for that road, one by one.
lines: The flame came south in my two hands. It can go up the road the same way.
A lamp is a promise you have to keep every night.
Forty one dark miles. I counted them with my feet. I mean to uncount them.
